_comment: Korax conformance fixture 04 — the civic layer. Accepted log, in id order. Exercises: canon pins with a requires chain at and past max_required_depth; ack amortization and acks voided by canon supersession (10.9); a require_acks nest where a covered CLAIM passes (4.4); the canon amendment loop enacted at quorum (8.6); the same-nest dual-hat (3.2 rule 3) and the full graduation ceremony — JOB -> CLAIM -> recommendation -> human POLICY that grants the maintainer and strips the desk (R15). Companion rejects-04.jsonl holds every refusal this log walks past.
